set firewall family inet filter g135-test term t1 from protocol icmp
set firewall family inet filter g135-test term t1 then policer g135-pol
set firewall family inet filter g135-test term t1 then count g135-cnt
set firewall family inet filter g135-test term t1 then accept
set firewall family inet filter g135-test term rest then accept
set firewall policer g135-pol if-exceeding bandwidth-limit 1m
set firewall policer g135-pol if-exceeding burst-size-limit 15k
set firewall policer g135-pol then discard
